analysis:

The two supplied units are unchanged base text from later in the file (lines 921-1842). The changed lines are not visible in those units, so the patch excerpt and hunk coordinates were my evidence for the change.

The addition changes no code, controls, endpoints or trust boundaries. The described test behavior (late-but-unexpired serving lease stays visible, removal advice requires a matching fresh decision, receipt-window boundary, disabled rollout, exact lease expiry) is consistent with the T-053, T-057 and TB-011 posture. The text explicitly disclaims native App Attest acceptance, CLI host probes and profile changes. It does not weaken any threat-model assumption.

The base-text units cover the testing docs for the prefix cache (T-041), SSD write budget, App Attest dispatch, native qualification and release signing. They are unchanged context, and I found no pre-existing inconsistencies introduced by this PR.

I could not verify that ProviderAuthorizationReadinessTests exists or that its production freshness logic matches the description. That code is outside the supplied evidence. This is a documentation accuracy question for integration, not a security finding. No new attack surface or regression was identified.
